name: [FinOps][Budget] Azure forecast projects month-end budget overrun

esqlQuery.esql: FROM metrics-azure.billing-* | WHERE azure.billing.usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC(1 month, NOW()) | STATS mtd_actual = SUM(azure.billing.actual_cost), mtd_forecast = SUM(azure.billing.forecast_cost) BY azure.subscription_id | EVAL monthly_budget = 50000.0, projected_total = mtd_actual + mtd_forecast | WHERE projected_total > monthly_budget | SORT projected_total DESC
